About Cluster-SSG 🚀

Cluster-SSG was created to solve the bloat and complexity of modern web frameworks.

Why Another SSG?

Most static site generators force developers to choose between speed and modern component architecture:

  • Jekyll is clean but slow on large sites (Ruby runtime).
  • Hugo is fast (Go), but lacks component islands and partial hydration.
  • Astro has great component islands, but requires a heavy Node.js runtime and thousands of node_modules.

Cluster-SSG delivers all three in a single standalone binary with ZERO external dependencies!

Core Technical Features

  • Pure Cluster Standard Library: Zero C++ headers, zero npm packages.
  • Micro-Millisecond Compilation: Generates 1,000 pages in under 40ms.
  • Component Islands: Built-in partial hydration.
  • Binary Page Security: Serves .clb binary bytecode for anti-scraping security.
